parameters.content:
Telegram AI bot, Lite

Answers your customers on Telegram from notes you write, and says so plainly when it cannot.

WHO IT IS FOR
Anyone answering the same handful of questions on Telegram all day: opening hours, shipping, returns, where an
order is. You write the facts once and the bot answers from them.

GOOD TO KNOW
This costs nothing to run as it ships. The default is Ollama on your own machine, so no API bill and no data
leaving your computer. You can switch to OpenAI or Anthropic in Settings if you would rather.
It answers ONLY from the notes you write. Anything your notes do not cover gets your own sentence back, never
a guess. That is the point of it.
It does not hand the conversation to a person. See the last line.

HOW IT WORKS
1. A message arrives from your Telegram bot.
2. Settings holds everything you change. Three fields matter: ai_model, business_name, knowledge.
3. The last few turns of that chat are loaded, so a follow-up question makes sense.
4. The AI is asked to answer using your notes and nothing else.
5. If it can answer, the answer is sent. If it cannot, your cannot_answer_message is sent instead.
6. If the AI cannot be reached at all, the customer still hears something.

HOW TO USE
Import this workflow, open Settings, and fill in business_name and knowledge. Put one fact per line in
knowledge. Connect your Telegram bot credential on the two Telegram nodes and activate.

REQUIREMENTS
A Telegram bot token, from BotFather.
Either Ollama running locally with a model pulled, or an OpenAI or Anthropic credential.

CUSTOMISING
The prompt is a Settings field, so you can change the bot's manner without touching a node.

This is the free version. It answers, and it stops there. The full version hands the chat to a human when
someone asks for one, tells you, and hands it back when you are done:
https://whop.com/biz_uabrQrwcT689nv/telegram-ai-bot-with-human-handoff

Settings

Everything you change is in this one node.

ai_model      the model name, e.g. qwen2.5:3b
business_name what the bot calls you
knowledge     your facts, one per line

Everything else already works as it stands.

The AI call

Build the AI request picks the URL and body for whichever provider Settings names. No API key is stored
anywhere in this workflow.

For Ollama, the default, there is nothing to set: it is keyless and local.
For OpenAI or Anthropic, open Ask the AI, set Authentication to Generic Credential Type, choose Header Auth,
and select your own credential. n8n keeps it encrypted and it never travels with the template.

If the call fails, the red output sends your cannot_answer_message so the customer is never left silent.
